models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Product category hierarchy for the shopping platform.

Defines the hierarchical taxonomy of product categories used for catalog organization and navigation.
Each category can have a parent category to form a tree structure, supporting multi-level categorization.

Categories are managed exclusively by admin users and determine how products are grouped for display in storefront navigation.

The category tree is cached for performance, and changes to parent categories will update all child category display paths.

This entity is referenced by shopping_mall_products to associate products with their categorization.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category in the hierarchy. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The display name of the category (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Clothing'). Must be unique within scope.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly identifier for the category, generated from name. Used in product URLs and SEO.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and included products.

plainFields.name: order_weight
plainFields.description: Determines display order in navigation menus. Lower values appear first.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Controls whether category is visible to customers. Inactive categories are hidden from storefront.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings that control platform behavior.

Stores key-value pairs of runtime configuration options that affect platform functionality.

Each configuration item is identified by a unique name and has a string value that may represent boolean, numeric, or string configurations.

The configuration system supports dynamic updates without requiring code deployment.

The system reads these configurations at service startup and caches them for performance.

This is a single-point-of-truth for system settings and overrides default values across all platform components.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key identifier (e.g., 'payment_gateway_type', 'max_cart_items'). Must be unique.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The configuration value stored as string. Can represent boolean ('true'/'false'), numeric ('123'), or string patterns.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of what this configuration controls and acceptable values.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Logical grouping of related configurations (e.g., 'payments', 'shipping', 'security').

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this configuration is currently active and applied by the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created or first registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_gateways
models.description:
Payment gateway configurations for processing transactions.

Defines the connection parameters and settings for external payment processors (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, KakaoPay).

Each gateway instance represents a specific configuration for one payment provider with different credentials for sandbox and production environments.

The system routes payments to the appropriate gateway based on customer region, currency, and configured preference.

This entity stores secure credentials (encryped) to communicate with external payment APIs.

Multiple gateways can be configured simultaneously to provide payment method options to customers.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the payment gateway (e.g., 'Stripe', 'PayPal', 'KakaoPay').

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: External provider system name (e.g., 'stripe', 'paypal', 'kakaopay'). Must match supported provider code.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this gateway is enabled for customer transactions.

plainFields.name: is_sandbox
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this configuration uses sandbox/test mode (true) or production mode (false).

plainFields.name: client_id
plainFields.description: Client/public identifier provided by the payment provider. Stored encrypted.

plainFields.name: secret_key
plainFields.description: Secret/private key provided by the payment provider. Stored encrypted and never exposed.

plainFields.name: merchant_id
plainFields.description: Merchant account identifier assigned by the payment provider.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Primary currency supported by this gateway configuration (e.g., 'USD', 'KRW').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the gateway configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the gateway configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: last_tested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this gateway configuration was last successfully tested for connectivity.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_carriers
models.description:
Delivery carrier configurations for order fulfillment.

Defines the connection settings for logistics providers (e.g., FedEx, DHL, CJ Logistics) used for shipment tracking and label generation.

Each carrier record contains authentication credentials, API endpoints, and service options for integration.

This entity enables the system to support multiple international carriers with region-specific settings.

The carrier selection during checkout determines shipping method availability and rate calculation.

This configuration is used by the system to generate shipping labels, track packages, and fetch delivery statuses.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the carrier (e.g., 'FedEx', 'DHL', 'CJ Logistics').

plainFields.name: provider
plainFields.description: External provider system name (e.g., 'fedex', 'dhl', 'cjs'). Must match supported provider code.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this carrier is enabled for shipping label generation and tracking.

plainFields.name: is_international
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this carrier supports international shipments.

plainFields.name: api_url
plainFields.description: Base API endpoint URL for the carrier's services.

plainFields.name: account_number
plainFields.description: Carrier account number assigned to the merchant. Stored encrypted.

plainFields.name: api_key
plainFields.description: API authentication key. Stored encrypted.

plainFields.name: api_secret
plainFields.description: API secret token. Stored encrypted.

plainFields.name: default_service
plainFields.description: Default service level (e.g., 'standard', 'express', 'overnight') for this carrier.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the carrier configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the carrier configuration was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_system_logs
models.description:
Audit logs of system events and administrative actions.

Records critical system events for security, debugging, and compliance purposes.

Contains immutable records of user actions, system errors, configuration changes, and security events.

This table is append-only and never modified or deleted after creation.

The logs are used for forensic analysis, traceability of administrative actions, and compliance auditing.

System logs provide a full history that can be queried for troubleshooting and investigation.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: The user or system component that performed the action. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id} or {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: level
plainFields.description: Log severity level (error, warning, info, debug, audit).

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Category of the event (e.g., 'auth', 'payment', 'inventory', 'config').

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Specific action performed (e.g., 'login', 'update_config', 'process_refund').

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: JSON string containing detailed context of the event, including parameters and object states.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: Source IP address of the request that triggered this log entry.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the client making the request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the event was logged. Immutable after creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_email_templates
models.description:
Pre-defined email templates for system-generated communications.

Stores the content structure for automated emails sent to customers, sellers, and administrators.

Each template includes subject line, HTML body, and plain text version, with placeholders for dynamic content.

Template fields are parsed at send time to substitute values like {{customer_name}}, {{order_id}}, {{delivery_date}}.

This allows easy modification of email content without code changes and supports multiple languages.

Templates are versioned and can be previewed and tested by admins before deployment.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the template (e.g., 'order_confirmation', 'password_reset').

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: Email subject line with optional placeholders like {{customer_name}}.

plainFields.name: body_html
plainFields.description: HTML content of the email, with placeholders for dynamic content like {{order_id}} or {{total_amount}}.

plainFields.name: body_text
plainFields.description: Plain text version of the email content for clients that don't support HTML.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Logical category of the email (e.g., 'transactional', 'marketing', 'notification').

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Language code this template is written in (e.g., 'en', 'ko').

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this template version is currently active and used by the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template version was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this template version was last modified.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Version identifier for template editing and rollback purposes (e.g., 'v1.2').

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description:
Primary customer identity and authentication entity.

Stores core identity information for customers who interact with the shopping mall platform. This entity represents a registered user who can browse products, create wishlists, add items to cart, and place orders. Customers must authenticate with email and password to access protected features.

Relationships:
- Each customer can have multiple sessions documented in shopping_mall_customer_sessions
- Each customer can have multiple carts in shopping_mall_carts
- Each customer can have multiple wishlists in shopping_mall_wishlists
- Each customer can have multiple orders in shopping_mall_orders
- Each customer can have multiple reviews in shopping_mall_product_reviews

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit compliance while allowing account deactivation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for authentication and communication. Required for login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plaintext. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Customer's first name for personalization and communication.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Customer's last name for personalization and communication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted, or null if active. Used for compliance and reversibility.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer has verified their email address. Required to access shopping and order functions.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Customer authentication session tracking table.

Tracks active and expired sessions for customer authentication. Each customer can have multiple concurrent sessions across devices. Sessions are used to maintain authenticated state across requests and track login activity for security auditing.

This table follows the mandatory session pattern: no additional fields allowed beyond specification.

Relationships:
- Each session belongs to exactly one customer via shopping_mall_customers.id
- Each session has a single customer context for identity linkage

Session lives from creation to expiration or manual logout.

This table is not independently managed by users but is maintained by the authentication system.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page from which the login request originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that referred the user to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description:
Primary seller identity and business authentication entity.

Represents a business or individual who lists and sells products on the shopping mall platform. Sellers must complete an approval process before being granted selling privileges.

Relationships:
- Each seller can have multiple sessions in shopping_mall_seller_sessions
- Each seller can have multiple products in shopping_mall_products
- Each seller can have multiple product reviews in shopping_mall_product_reviews
- Each seller can have multiple orders in shopping_mall_orders
- Each seller can have multiple payouts in shopping_mall_seller_payouts

Soft deletion is supported, and status tracking manages the onboarding workflow (pending, approved, rejected, suspended).

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique business email address used for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plaintext.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal name of the business or seller.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted, or null if active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the seller account: 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended'. Controls access to selling features.

plainFields.name: is_onboarded
plainFields.description: Indicates whether seller has completed bank account setup and verification. Required before listing products.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Seller authentication session tracking table.

Tracks active and expired sessions for seller authentication. Each seller can have multiple concurrent sessions across devices for managing their storefront.

This table follows the mandatory session pattern: no additional fields allowed beyond specification.

Relationships:
- Each session belongs to exactly one seller via shopping_mall_sellers.id

Session lives from creation to expiration or manual logout.

This table is not independently managed by users but is maintained by the authentication system.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page from which the login request originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that referred the user to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrators
models.description:
Primary administrative identity entity with elevated permissions.

Represents platform administrators with system-wide management permissions including user management, product moderation, seller approval, and refund handling. These accounts require enhanced security controls including 2FA and audit logging.

Relationships:
- Each admin can have multiple sessions in shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
- Each admin can perform multiple actions logged in shopping_mall_admin_actions
- Each admin can resolve disputes logged in shopping_mall_admin_dispute_resolutions

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trail while allowing account deactivation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique administration email address used for authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: BCrypt-hashed password for authentication. Never stored in plaintext.

plainFields.name: first_name
plainFields.description: Administrator's first name for identification and communication.

plainFields.name: last_name
plainFields.description: Administrator's last name for identification and communication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft-deleted, or null if active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the admin account: 'active', 'suspended', 'disabled'. Controls system access.

plainFields.name: is_2fa_enabled
plainFields.description: Indicates whether two-factor authentication is enabled for this admin account, mandatory for security.

models.name: shopping_mall_administrator_sessions
models.description:
Administrator authentication session tracking table.

Tracks active and expired sessions for admin authentication. Admins require higher security standards and can have multiple concurrent sessions for system management.

This table follows the mandatory session pattern: no additional fields allowed beyond specification.

Relationships:
- Each session belongs to exactly one admin via shopping_mall_administrators.id

Session lives from creation to expiration or manual logout.

This table is not independently managed by users but is maintained by the authentication system.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page from which the login request originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that referred the user to the login page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires; null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product listings in the shopping mall catalog.

Represents the main product offering with shared attributes like title, description, and category. Each product can have multiple variants with different pricing and inventory. Products have lifecycle states: draft, active, and inactive.

Products are directly searchable and browsable by customers through category navigation and global search. Sellers create and manage products in their dashboards with status controls. Products remain in the system even when inactive or deleted to preserve historical order data for reporting and compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category this product belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created and manages this product. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title displayed in listings and search results. Must be 3-200 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description explaining features, specifications, and usage. Must be 10-5000 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product lifecycle state: draft, active, inactive. Controls visibility to customers. Only active products are searchable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last product update, including status changes or metadata edits.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, product becomes archived and invisible to customers. Historical order data preserved.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Specific configurations of a product with individual pricing and inventory.

Each variant represents a unique combination of attributes like color, size, or material. Variants inherit core attributes of the parent product but have unique SKU, price, and stock quantity. Linked directly to a product and cannot exist independently.

Variants are not directly searchable by customers — they appear as selectable options on the product detail page. Inventory is tracked per variant, allowing accurate stock allocation during cart addition and checkout operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The parent product this variant belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier in format {CATEGORYCODE}-{COLOR}-{SIZE}-{SEQ}. Auto-generated during creation.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Retail price of this variant in USD. Must be between $0.01 and $9,999.99.

plainFields.name: inventory
plainFields.description: Current available inventory quantity for this variant. Updated automatically on order confirmation and returns.

plainFields.name: attributes
plainFields.description: JSON string containing key-value pairs of variant attributes (e.g., {\"color\": \"red\", \"size\": \"L\"}). Used for frontend display and filtering.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to price, inventory, or attributes.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Product images attached to specific products for visual display.

Each image is associated with a product and stores reference to the image file URL. Used to enhance product detail pages and search listings. Multiple images per product are allowed.

Images are not standalone entities — they are always managed through their parent product's API. Used for store presentation, but do not require independent addressability or search.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this image belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: Full URL to the image file. Must be a valid web-accessible URI (HTTP/HTTPS).

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: True if this image should be used as the main product thumbnail. Only one image per product can be primary.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was uploaded.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags
models.description:
Tags assigned to products for categorization, filtering, and search optimization.

Associates descriptive keywords or categories to products (e.g., "on-sale", "eco-friendly", "best-seller"). Helps improve discoverability and supports customer filtering criteria.

Each tag is bound to a single product and can be reused across multiple products. Tags are managed through product edit interfaces and do not require dedicated API endpoints.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this tag belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: tag
plainFields.description: The text value of the tag. Must be 1-50 characters, alphanumeric and hyphen/underscore only.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag was added to the product.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews_queue
models.description:
Queue for pending product reviews awaiting admin moderation.

Contains customer-submitted reviews that require manual review before being published. Used to enforce community guidelines, filter spam, and prevent inappropriate content from appearing publicly.

Reviews in the queue are not visible to customers. This table is the interface for admin moderation workflows and must support independent search, filtering, and approval/rejection operations by administrators. It is a system-managed administrative table and not directly accessible or creatable by customers. All entries are populated automatically by customer review submission system with status pending, and only admins can change the status to approved or rejected.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5 submitted by customer.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Text content of the review, limited to 1000 characters. May contain profanity or spam requiring moderation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Moderation status: pending, approved, rejected. Only reviews with status 'approved' are published to the product.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the review.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review status was last updated by an admin.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Primary shopping cart container for each customer.

Represents the user's active shopping cart that holds multiple cart items before checkout.
Each cart is associated with exactly one customer and contains a collection of cart items with product variants, quantities, and prices at the time they were added.

Carts remain active until the user checks out or explicitly empties their cart. Cart items can be added, removed, or have their quantities modified. The cart itself does not store product prices directly but references cart_items which capture the price snapshot at addition time.

Carts are retained for active sessions and can be restored across devices via authenticated sessions. When a cart is checked out, its items are moved to order_items and the cart is cleared but not deleted.

Soft delete capability allows users to restore accidentally deleted carts within a limited time window for customer experience purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's primary key. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shopping cart was last modified (items added/removed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, cart is active. If set, cart is marked for deletion but record preserved for audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual items within a customer's shopping cart with price snapshot.

Represents a specific product variant added to a shopping cart with its quantity and price as it was at the time of addition.

Each cart item is linked to a specific shopping_mall_carts record and a shopping_mall_product_variants record. The price is stored as a snapshot to ensure the customer pays the correct price even if the product's price changes later.

This table follows the snapshot pattern to record state at time of cart addition, preserving historical pricing and variant details for accurate billing and audit trails.

Cart items can be removed from the cart (soft delete) but are retained in the database for order history and return purposes. Quantity can be modified while the item remains in the cart, but the price snapshot is immutable once item is added.

The combination of cart_id and product_variant_id must be unique to prevent duplicate items in the same cart.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_id
foreignFields.description: Shopping cart that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant that was added to cart. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this variant added to the cart. Must be at least 1.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Unit price of the product variant at the time it was added to the cart. This is a snapshot value to preserve pricing accuracy for billing, even if the product price changes later.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was added to the cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item's quantity was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, item is in cart. If set, item has been removed from cart but record preserved for audit and order history.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description:
Primary wishlist container for each customer.

Represents the user's personal list of products they are interested in purchasing in the future.

Each wishlist is associated with exactly one customer and contains a collection of wishlist items with product variants.

Wishlists remain active indefinitely unless the user explicitly deletes them. Items in the wishlist do not imply intent to purchase but indicate interest for future consideration.

Wishlists can be shared with others in some contexts (as per business policy, not implemented in this schema) but are primarily private to the user. Users can move items between wishlist and cart.

Soft delete capability allows users to restore accidentally deleted wishlists within a limited time window for customer experience purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's primary key. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last modified (items added/removed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, wishlist is active. If set, wishlist is marked for deletion but record preserved for audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description:
Individual items within a customer's wishlist.

Represents a specific product variant added to a wishlist with its timestamp.

Each wishlist item is linked to a specific shopping_mall_wishlists record and a shopping_mall_product_variants record.

This table follows a snapshot pattern to record the variant state at time of addition for consistency in gift suggestions and future purchase intent tracking.

Wishlist items can be removed from the wishlist (soft delete) but are retained in the database for audit trails and to support "restored from wishlist" functionality.

Unlike cart items, wishlist items do not store price information since they don't represent immediate purchase intent. The price is always read from the current product variant when the wishlist item is viewed.

The combination of wishlist_id and product_variant_id must be unique to prevent duplicate items in the same wishlist.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Wishlist that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant that was added to wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was added to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was last modified (reordered or moved).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, item is in wishlist. If set, item has been removed from wishlist but record preserved for audit and recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Core order record representing a customer's purchase transaction.

Each order captures the state of a customer's purchase at the moment of confirmation, referencing the customer, shipping address, payment details, and order items. The order total, tax, shipping, and discount values are snapshotted to ensure financial integrity even if product prices or fees change later.

Orders transition through multiple statuses (pending_payment, confirmed, shipped, delivered, canceled, refunded) as part of the fulfillment workflow. Once an order is confirmed, all associated data becomes immutable except for status updates.

The order record serves as the central anchor for all subsequent operations including fulfillment, returns, disputes, and reporting. Reference to customer_id links to the shopping_mall_customers table for customer identity, while references to other entities provide contextual data for business operations.

plainFields.name: subtotal

plainFields.name: shipping_amount

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual line items within an order, capturing product details at time of purchase.

Each order item represents one product variant purchased in an order, with specific pricing and quantity locked at checkout. This table ensures the transaction record remains accurate even if the underlying product variant's price or availability changes later.

The item references the shopping_mall_product_variants table to identify the specific product variant, but all pricing data is stored directly in this table to maintain historical integrity. Inventory reduction occurs through payment confirmation, and these items are not connected to cart items which represent intent rather than commitment.

Order items are managed exclusively through their parent shopping_mall_orders table and do not have direct user interaction outside the context of an order.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that this item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant purchased. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this variant purchased. Must be positive integer.

plainFields.name: price_per_unit
plainFields.description: Price of this variant at time of purchase, including any variant-specific adjustments.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title as it appeared at time of purchase, for historical reference.

plainFields.name: variant_description
plainFields.description: Variant-specific attributes (e.g., color, size) as they appeared at time of purchase, for historical reference.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payments
models.description:
Payment details captured at time of checkout for financial record and dispute resolution.

This table stores the payment method type and reference identifiers (e.g., payment gateway token) but never stores sensitive card data. Payment information is snapshotted to ensure accurate reconciliation even if payment methods are modified or removed from customer profiles later.

The actual payment processing occurs through a third-party gateway, and this table records only the reference information needed for audit, refund processing, and customer communication.

Payment details are managed exclusively through the parent shopping_mall_orders table and are not directly manipulated by users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_payment_gateway_id
foreignFields.description: Payment gateway used for this transaction. {@link shopping_mall_payment_gateways.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_method_type
plainFields.description: Type of payment method used: 'credit_card', 'digital_wallet', 'bank_transfer'.

plainFields.name: payment_gateway_reference
plainFields.description: Token or identifier returned by payment gateway (e.g., payment_intent_id, transaction_id). Never stores full card numbers.

plainFields.name: last_four_digits
plainFields.description: Last four digits of the payment method for customer reference (e.g., 4242 for a credit card).

plainFields.name: billing_address
plainFields.description: Billing address as provided during checkout, stored for reconciliation purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipping_addresses
models.description:
Immutable snapshot of the shipping address at time of purchase for accurate fulfillment completion.

Unlike customer profile addresses, this table captures the exact address information as provided during checkout, including any manual corrections. This ensures fulfillment is never affected by subsequent changes to a customer's default address.

The address fields are stored as plain text strings since they represent a single point-in-time snapshot, not a linked relational entity. This table has no direct user interaction beyond the checkout process and is always managed as part of an order record.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the person receiving the package.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Full street address including building number and unit, if applicable.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or town name where delivery is being made.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name (e.g., California, Seoul, Ontario).

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code or zip code for the delivery location.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name (e.g., South Korea, United States) in full form for clarity.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Phone number for courier delivery attempts or delivery coordination.

plainFields.name: instructions
plainFields.description: Special delivery instructions provided by customer (e.g., "Leave at back door").

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipping address snapshot was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipments
models.description:
Tracking information for physically shipped orders, linked to carrier services.

This table captures the carrier and tracking details when a seller marks an order as shipped. The tracking number and carrier name allow customers and support teams to monitor delivery progress through external logistics systems.

Shipment records are generated only once the order status transitions to "shipped" and are solely managed by the system in response to seller actions, not directly by customers.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order being shipped. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_shipping_carrier_id
foreignFields.description: Logistics provider handling this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_carriers.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-specific tracking number assigned to this shipment. Format depends on carrier (e.g., 1Z999AA12345678908).

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Estimated arrival date provided by the carrier at time of shipment generation.

plainFields.name: actual_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Actual date when carrier confirmed delivery (auto-filled via webhook or manual update).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was last updated (e.g., tracking status change).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_statuses
models.description:
Reference table defining the valid status codes for order lifecycle management.

This table contains the authoritative list of all possible statuses an order can have throughout its lifecycle, allowing consistent status transitions and business rule enforcement. Each status has a code and description used across the system for display, logic, and reporting.

This is a lookup table that is referenced by shopping_mall_orders but does not contain data directly manipulated by users. Its content is maintained by platform administrators and is used to enforce valid status transitions in business workflows.

plainFields.name: status_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the status (e.g., 'pending_payment', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'canceled', 'refunded'). Lowercase with underlines.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the status shown to users (e.g., "Pending Payment", "Order Confirmed").

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining the status meaning and typical use case in the order lifecycle.

plainFields.name: is_terminal
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this status ends the order lifecycle (e.g., delivered, canceled, refunded). If true, no further status changes are allowed.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Numeric order for displaying statuses in chronological sequence (lower numbers = earlier in lifecycle).

models.name: shopping_mall_order_snapshots
models.description:
Historical audit records capturing the complete state of orders at time of confirmation.

This snapshot table preserves a point-in-time copy of critical order data including items, pricing, shipping, and payment details as they existed at the moment the order was confirmed. This ensures financial accuracy for refunds, disputes, tax reporting, and compliance even when source data changes.

All data in this table is immutable and append-only. Snapshots are generated automatically when an order transitions from "pending_payment" to "confirmed". No user or system modification of this table is permitted after creation. This table is read-only for operational purposes and used for compliance audits and historical reporting.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Original order this snapshot was created from. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: The order number at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: customer_id
plainFields.description: Customer ID that placed the order at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: customer_email

plainFields.description: Sum of all order items' prices at time of snapshot (before tax and shipping).

plainFields.description: Tax amount calculated and locked at time of snapshot based on shipping address and product types.

plainFields.name: shipping_amount
plainFields.description: Shipping cost locked at snapshot time based on selected method and destination.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: Total discount value applied at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order total locked at snapshot time (subtotal + tax + shipping - discount).

plainFields.description: Payment method type used at time of snapshot (credit_card, digital_wallet, bank_transfer).
