models.name: shopping_mall_inventory
models.description:
Tracks current stock levels for each product variant.

Maintains the real-time inventory count for every product variant in the system. This table is the single source of truth for available stock quantities that are used during order processing, cart additions, and checkout validations.

Each record corresponds to one product variant and must always have a non-negative quantity. Stock levels are atomic and updated through transactions to prevent overselling. The quantity field is modified by order confirmations (decrease), cancellations (increase), and manual corrections.

This entity is referenced by shopping_mall_inventory_audit for change tracking and shopping_mall_inventory_alerts for threshold monitoring. Foreign keys link to product_variants and sellers to maintain accountability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant whose inventory is being tracked. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this inventory. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current available stock quantity. Must be 0 or greater. This is the primary source of truth for inventory availability during purchases.

plainFields.name: reorder_threshold
plainFields.description: Minimum quantity threshold that triggers low-stock alerts. When inventory falls below this value, an alert is generated to notify the seller.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated (quantity or threshold changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was logically deleted (archived). Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_audit
models.description:
Records all historical changes to inventory quantities with context.

An immutable audit trail that captures every inventory adjustment event. Each record represents a delta change to inventory quantity, including the user who made the change, the reason, previous and new quantities, and timestamps.

This table is essential for compliance, reconciliation, and troubleshooting inventory discrepancies. It supports detailed forensic analysis of stock movements. Changes are made through system events (order confirmations), manual corrections, or sync operations.

The table links to the modified inventory record, the acting user (seller or admin), and includes a change type category for filtering. The notes field can contain detailed descriptions of the adjustment reason.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_id
foreignFields.description: The inventory record that was modified. {@link shopping_mall_inventory.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who made this inventory adjustment (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The admin who made this inventory adjustment (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_quantity
plainFields.description: Inventory quantity before this change. Allows calculation of delta (current - previous) for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: new_quantity
plainFields.description: Inventory quantity after this change. This represents the new state after the adjustment.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Category describing why this change occurred. Valid values: "order_confirmation", "order_cancellation", "manual_correction", "sync_receipt", "sync_adjustment", "system_reset".

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional context about this inventory change. May include reasons like "Restocked after vendor delivery" or "Q3 inventory adjustment - count verified." Used for searchable audit trail.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit record was last updated (typically not changed after creation).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_alerts
models.description:
Tracks automated low-stock alerts for product variants.

Automatically generated records that notify sellers when their inventory falls below the defined reorder threshold. Each alert represents a single monitoring event and is marked as either active, resolved, or suppressed.

Alerts are created when inventory quantity drops to or below the threshold set in shopping_mall_inventory. Each alert is resolved when inventory is replenished above the threshold. Alerts help ensure sellers maintain optimal stock levels and avoid lost sales.

Alerts can be manually suppressed if inventory is known to be temporarily unavailable but remains correct in the system. Each alert is linked to the specific inventory record and the seller who owns it.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_inventory_id
foreignFields.description: The inventory record that triggered this alert. {@link shopping_mall_inventory.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who is notified by this alert. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: triggered_quantity
plainFields.description: The inventory quantity at the time the alert was triggered. This is the exact value that fell below the threshold.

plainFields.name: triggered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory quantity first fell below the reorder threshold and the alert was generated.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved (inventory replenished above threshold). Null if active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the alert. Valid values: "active", "resolved", "suppressed". Active = inventory still below threshold. Resolved = inventory restored. Suppressed = alert manually suspended.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes when an alert is manually suppressed. For example: "Inventory down due to maintenance, expected restock in 2 days".

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_sync_logs
models.description:
Logs synchronization events between external warehouse systems and the platform's inventory.

Maintains a record of all automated inventory sync operations from external logistics partners, warehouse management systems, or physical counting devices. Each entry represents a batch sync operation that may update multiple inventory records.

This table is critical for reconciling system inventory with external sources. Sync logs capture the source system, sync method, timing, success status, and processed quantity changes. They allow administrators to trace inventory discrepancies back to external sync events.

Each sync operation may involve hundreds of inventory updates, all tracked through this log entry and linked to corresponding inventory_audit entries via common timestamp ranges.

plainFields.name: source_system
plainFields.description: The external system from which inventory data was synced. Examples: "WarehouseHub-PROD", "VendoraAPI", "ManualCount_20240515".

plainFields.name: sync_method
plainFields.description: How the sync was performed. Valid values: "api_polling", "webhook_push", "bulk_csv_upload", "manual_import".

plainFields.name: synced_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this sync operation began and the data was received by the platform.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this sync operation completed processing. Null if still in progress.

plainFields.name: total_records_processed
plainFields.description: Total number of inventory records affected by this sync operation.

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the sync operation completed successfully without errors.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Detailed description of any error that occurred during the sync. Null if success = true.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional context about this sync operation, such as batch ID from external system or filename of uploaded CSV.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this log record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this log record was last updated (when updated from pending to completed).

models.name: shopping_mall_shipments
models.description:
Core shipment entity that links orders to carrier logistics and tracking.

Represents the physical transportation of purchased goods from seller to customer. Each shipment is tied to a specific order and carrier, with tracking information managed separately in shipment_tracking and delivery_attempts tables.

Important for audit trails during delivery disputes and logistics performance analysis. Soft deletion is supported to maintain historical records even if shipments are cancelled or voided.

Relates to orders via order_id and to carriers via carrier_id. The status field reflects order lifecycle state, while tracking and delivery attempts are handled as separate entities for real-time carrier updates.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The associated order this shipment belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: carrier_id
foreignFields.description: The shipping carrier responsible for this shipment. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_carriers.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the shipment. Valid values: pending, shipped, out_for_delivery, delivered, returned_to_sender, cancelled. Follows order lifecycle transitions.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: The carrier's unique tracking identifier for this shipment. Format varies by carrier (e.g., 123456789012, 9400110200000000000000). Used to link to carrier's tracking system.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Predicted date and time of delivery based on carrier's service level and origin/destination.

plainFields.name: shipping_method
plainFields.description: Type of shipping service selected (e.g., standard, express, overnight).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this shipment was soft-deleted (e.g., cancelled). NULL if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipment_tracking
models.description:
Event log of carrier-provided tracking status updates for each shipment.

Represents discrete, timestamped status events from external carriers (e.g., "shipped", "in transit", "out for delivery", "delivered"). Unlike the main shipment status field (which reflects business state), this table captures granular carrier updates in real time.

This is a subsidiary table managed exclusively through its parent shipment. Each tracking event is immutable once created and cannot be modified or deleted. The status field is critical for accurate delivery predictions, customer notifications, and dispute resolution.

Historical tracking data helps evaluate carrier performance and investigate delivery issues. This table enables real-time customer tracking pages without coupling system state to carrier API responses.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: The shipment this tracking event belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Specific carrier-provided status event (e.g., shipped, delivered, delivery_attempt_failed, customs_clearance_completed). Follows carrier's standard status codes.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Geographical location (city, region, country) where this status update was recorded by the carrier.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional carrier-provided details about this status update (e.g., 'Left at front door', 'Attempted delivery - no one home', 'Delayed by weather').

plainFields.name: event_timestamp
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when this status update was received from the carrier's system. This may differ significantly from system.timestamp.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tracking event was recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tracking event was last updated (if applicable).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tracking record was soft-deleted. Should always be NULL as tracking events are immutable.

models.name: shopping_mall_delivery_attempts
models.description:
Record of every delivery attempt made on a shipment, including outcomes and customer interactions.

Captures specific delivery event details such as time attempted, outcome (success/failure), delivery personnel actions, and customer responses. Each delivery attempt during a shipment's lifecycle is logged as a separate record.

The status field categorizes the result of each attempt: delivered, failed, refused, partial_delivery. This table is essential for investigating delivery failures, documenting proof of attempt, and managing re-delivery requests.

This is a subsidiary table managed through its parent shipment. Attempt records are append-only and immutable, preserving an audit trail of delivery efforts that corresponds to tracking events.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: The shipment this delivery attempt belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Outcome of the delivery attempt. Valid values: delivered, failed, refused, partial_delivery, attempted_but_not_handled.

plainFields.name: attempted_at
plainFields.description: The exact date and time when the delivery attempt occurred.

plainFields.name: delivery_person_name
plainFields.description: Name of the delivery person who attempted delivery (if available from carrier).

plainFields.name: delivery_person_id
plainFields.description: Unique identifier assigned by the carrier to the delivery personnel.

plainFields.name: signature
plainFields.description: Digital signature collected from customer (base64-encoded or link to image). NULL if no signature was required or collected.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional context from driver (e.g., 'Left with neighbor', 'Doorbell rang but no answer', 'Customer requested to leave at back door').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delivery attempt was soft-deleted. Should always be NULL as delivery attempts are immutable historical records.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_zones
models.description:
Geographic regions used by the platform to define shipping rate boundaries and service availability.

Defines standardized shipping zones (geographic areas) that determine applicable rates based on origin and destination. Zones can represent cities, states, countries, or custom regions defined by the platform/operator.

This is a primary entity because it serves as a reference table used by the shipping_rates table to correlate prices with destinations. Zones are manually managed by platform admins and are not tied to specific user data.

Useful for excluding certain areas from delivery, defining service tiers, and calculating shipping costs accurately.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the zone (e.g., 'Zone 1: Seoul Metropolitan Area', 'International: Europe'). Must be unique within the system.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of boundaries, included regions, and any special rules for this zone.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this zone is currently active for shipping. Inactive zones cannot be selected for new rates.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was soft-deleted. NULL if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_rates
models.description:
Pricing rules for shipping based on zones, weights, and service levels.

Defines the cost structure for shipping based on origin zone, destination zone, package weight, and requested service (standard, express, etc.). These rates are established by platform administrators or derived from carrier agreements and used during checkout to calculate shipping fees.

A primary entity because it represents a core business rule that customers directly interact with when choosing shipping options. Rates are ruled by the platform rather than the seller and can be updated globally. Each rate record is associated with a specific origin and destination zone combination.

The flat rate or weight-based pricing is stored as a double precision value. This table is referenced during cart calculations to determine final shipping cost presented to the customer.

foreignFields.name: origin_zone_id
foreignFields.description: The shipping zone from which this shipment originates. Typically the seller's location. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_zones.id}.

foreignFields.name: destination_zone_id
foreignFields.description: The shipping zone where this shipment is being delivered. Typically the buyer's location. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_zones.id}.

plainFields.name: service_level
plainFields.description: Type of shipping service this rate applies to. Valid values: standard, express, overnight, same_day, economy. Must be aligned with carrier offerings.

plainFields.name: weight_from
plainFields.description: Minimum weight (in kg) for this rate tier. For example, if weight_from=0 and weight_to=1, this rate applies to items weighing 0 to 1 kg.

plainFields.name: weight_to
plainFields.description: Maximum weight (in kg) for this rate tier. For example, if weight_from=0 and weight_to=1, this rate applies to items weighing 0 to 1 kg.

plainFields.name: is_flat_rate
plainFields.description: If true, the rate applies regardless of weight within the defined range. If false, the rate is calculated based on weight and rate per kg.

plainFields.name: rate
plainFields.description: The shipping cost in USD for this rate. When is_flat_rate=true, this is the fixed fee. When false, this is the cost per kilogram.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this rate is currently active for use during checkout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this rate was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this rate was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this rate was soft-deleted. NULL if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_reviews
models.description:
Customer-submitted product reviews with moderation status.

Each review represents a customer's feedback on a purchased product. Reviews go through a moderation lifecycle before becoming publicly visible. The content is stored as a snapshot at time of submission to preserve user intent and prevent tampering after moderation decisions.

Reviews are associated with products and customers, and their status (pending/approved/rejected) determines visibility. Customers can only have one review per product, with a 48-hour edit window before review becomes final.

All draft and rejected reviews are preserved for audit purposes only.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who wrote the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's active session at time of submission. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current moderation status of the review. Valid values: pending, approved, rejected. Default is pending before moderation.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating given by customer (1-5). Mandatory field. Must be integer between 1 and 5.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief headline or summary of the review. Maximum length: 200 characters.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Detailed review content written by customer. Maximum length: 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was originally submitted. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified (e.g., during edit window).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was marked as deleted. Null if review is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_review_replies
models.description:
Seller responses to customer product reviews.

Seller replies are managed as separate entities following the review's moderation lifecycle. These responses appear publicly only after the parent review has been approved.

Only the original seller of the product may reply to a review, and each review may have only one reply. Admin recommendations may be marked separately.

Seller replies have no separate moderation status - their visibility is tied to the parent review's approval state. Replies are not editable after submission to maintain transparency.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: The customer review being replied to. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Seller profile who wrote this reply. {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Text response from the seller to the customer review. Maximum length: 500 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the reply was submitted. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reply was marked as deleted. Null if still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_reports
models.description:
System-managed records of customer-reported problematic reviews.

Users may report reviews that violate community guidelines. Each report includes the reporter's identity, reason for reporting, and timestamp. Reports are automatically linked to the review being reported.

Reported reviews enter a moderation queue and are hidden from public view until resolved. Each review may have multiple reports from different users.

This table serves as an audit trail for moderation actions and is used to identify patterns of abuse or malicious reporting.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: Review being reported. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who submitted the report. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the report. Must be selected from predefined options: spam, offensive, inaccurate, misleading, impersonation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed explanation provided by the reporter. Maximum length: 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was submitted.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of this report: pending, reviewed, dismissed, action_taken. Default is pending.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_moderation_logs
models.description:
Immutable audit trail of all moderation actions taken on reviews.

Every status change, report resolution, or admin intervention on a review is recorded here with full context. This table follows an append-only pattern and cannot be modified after creation.

Modifications include: approval/rejection of reviews, dismissal of reports, deletion, and edits to ratings broken by policy violations.

Each log entry records the actor (admin or automated system), action performed, previous state, new state, and timestamp. This enables full transparency in the moderation process and provides auditability for compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review affected by this moderation action. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who performed this action. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}. If automated, use null.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_report_id
foreignFields.description: Report that triggered this moderation action (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_review_reports.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action performed: approved, rejected, reported, resolved, deleted, edited, flagged, restored, bulk_action.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: The review's status before this action. Null if no prior status (e.g., creation).

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The review's status after this action. Null if deleted.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation for the moderation decision. Mandatory for admin actions; auto-generated for automated actions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was performed. Immutable record.

plainFields.name: is_automated
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this action was performed by an automated system rather than an admin. True for machine actions, false for human.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_rating_statistics
models.description:
Materialized view for weekly product review rating statistics with calculated metrics.

This table is a read-only, fully denormalized aggregation of review data used to optimize performance of product rating displays. The values are computed nightly by a backend job and refreshed automatically.

This entity maintains the following denormalized calculations: total reviews, average rating, rating distribution (1-5 star counts), and total helpful votes. All metrics are stored as snapshots to avoid on-the-fly computation.

The data is sourced entirely from shopping_mall_product_reviews with status=approved and doesn't include deleted or pending reviews.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product these statistics are for. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: total_reviews
plainFields.description: Total number of approved reviews for this product. Recalculated daily from shopping_mall_product_reviews.

plainFields.name: average_rating
plainFields.description: Weighted average of all approved reviews for this product (1-5 scale). Calculated as SUM(rating)/total_reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_1_count
plainFields.description: Number of 1-star reviews for this product. Only counts approved reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_2_count
plainFields.description: Number of 2-star reviews for this product. Only counts approved reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_3_count
plainFields.description: Number of 3-star reviews for this product. Only counts approved reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_4_count
plainFields.description: Number of 4-star reviews for this product. Only counts approved reviews.

plainFields.name: rating_5_count
plainFields.description: Number of 5-star reviews for this product. Only counts approved reviews.

plainFields.name: last_updated
plainFields.description: Timestamp when these statistics were last recalculated. Does not reflect individual review changes.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_edits
models.description:
Immutable audit trail of all edits made to product reviews during the 48-hour edit window.

This table logs every content modification to a review within its editable period before final submission. Each edit captures the full revision state, timestamp, and context.

This audit trail is mandatory per "Review and Rating Rules" to support moderation decisions, detect abuse during edit windows, and enable potential rollback features.

All edits are immutable records created by the system when customers update their reviews. The table is append-only and never modified after creation.

Important: This table is not publicly exposed but used internally by the moderation system to track revision history.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review for which this edit was made. {@link shopping_mall_product_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: title_before
plainFields.description: Review title state before this edit. Full text snapshot of the previous version.

plainFields.name: title_after
plainFields.description: Review title state after this edit. Full text snapshot of the new version.

plainFields.name: body_before
plainFields.description: Review body state before this edit. Full text snapshot of the previous version.

plainFields.name: body_after
plainFields.description: Review body state after this edit. Full text snapshot of the new version.

plainFields.name: rating_before
plainFields.description: Star rating state before this edit. Previous value (1-5) if changed.

plainFields.name: rating_after
plainFields.description: Star rating state after this edit. New value (1-5) if changed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit was recorded. Immutable record of when the change occurred.

plainFields.name: edit_number
plainFields.description: Sequential number of this edit in the series for this review. Starts at 1 for first edit.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_applications
models.description:
Seller application records submitted by new business entities seeking to join the marketplace.

Tracks the complete lifecycle of seller registration, from initial application submission through admin review and approval/rejection. Applications must be approved before sellers can list products or access financial systems. Each application links to corresponding verification documents and creates a seller profile upon approval.

Integration with identity services for independent authentication. Applications maintain audit trails with timestamps and admin review history. Soft deletion preserves data for compliance while allowing administrative cleanup.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Applying customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal business name as registered with government authorities.

plainFields.name: tax_id
plainFields.description: Government-issued tax identification number for business validation.

plainFields.name: application_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the application: pending_review, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Admin-provided reason for application rejection. Required when status is 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the application was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the application status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the application was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_verification_documents
models.description:
Documents submitted by sellers to verify their business identity and legitimacy.

Contains scanned copies of government-issued documents including business license, tax documentation, and bank account verification. Each document is linked to a seller application and must be approved before seller account activation. Documents are stored securely with encrypted access controls.

The document upload process is managed through the seller application workflow. All documents have an expiration date and require periodic re-verification. Documents are only accessible to approved admin staff and are archived when the seller account is terminated.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_application_id
foreignFields.description: Associated seller application {@link shopping_mall_seller_applications.id}.

plainFields.name: document_type
plainFields.description: Type of document: business_license, tax_certificate, bank_statement, government_id.

plainFields.name: document_url
plainFields.description: Secure URL to the uploaded document file in object storage.

plainFields.name: document_name
plainFields.description: Original filename uploaded by the seller.

plainFields.name: document_expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiry date of the document when re-verification will be required.

plainFields.name: verified_by
plainFields.description: Admin user who reviewed and approved the document {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was verified by an admin.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document metadata was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the document was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_bank_accounts
models.description:
Bank account information for sellers to receive payout disbursements.

Stores secure banking details for each approved seller to enable automated payments. Account information is retrieved through tokenized payment system integration to ensure PCI compliance. Each seller can have one or more bank accounts for different currencies or financial institutions.

Bank accounts are verified through micro-deposits before being enabled for payouts. Account details are never stored in plaintext and are only accessible to treasury and accounting departments. Account changes require admin approval and audit logging.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Associated seller profile {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: bank_name
plainFields.description: Name of the financial institution holding the account.

plainFields.name: account_number_last_four
plainFields.description: Last four digits of the bank account for user identification.

plainFields.name: routing_number
plainFields.description: Bank routing number for domestic transfers.

plainFields.name: account_type
plainFields.description: Type of account: checking, savings, business.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency of the bank account (ISO 4217 code).

plainFields.name: account_holder_name
plainFields.description: Full legal name of the account holder as it appears on bank records.

plainFields.name: verification_status
plainFields.description: Status of bank account verification: pending, verified, failed.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Indicates if this is the default payout account for the seller.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the bank account was added to the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the bank account information was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the bank account was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_profiles
models.description:
Core seller identity and business profile information.

Represents the main entity that stores the seller's personalized information including business name, description, logo, and contact details. Each seller has exactly one profile that serves as their public presence on the marketplace. Profiles are continuously updated by sellers and contain both public-facing and administrative data.

Profiles are linked to applications during onboarding and to bank accounts for financial operations. Profile information controls storefront appearance and determines which seller-related features are available. Profile updates are audited for security and compliance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Original customer account from which seller status was granted {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Public-facing name of the seller's business.

plainFields.name: business_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the seller's business, products, and values. Limited to 500 characters.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: Secure URL to the seller's logo image file in object storage.

plainFields.name: contact_email
plainFields.description: Business contact email for customer inquiries.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Business contact phone number.

plainFields.name: business_address
plainFields.description: Legal business address matching government verification documents.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller account status: active, inactive, suspended, terminated.

plainFields.name: performance_score
plainFields.description: Composite performance rating based on customer feedback, shipping speed, and dispute rates.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile was activated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_settings
models.description:
Configuration preferences and operational settings for seller accounts.

Stores user-defined preferences and configuration options that control seller behavior on the platform. Settings include notification preferences, payout thresholds, currency display options, and display settings for storefronts. Settings are applied at the seller profile level and may have defaults inherited from system configuration.

Settings are modified through a self-service interface and should not affect other sellers. Setting changes trigger audit logging for security. The profile of this table is subsidiary because it is always managed through the seller profile interface, not independently.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Associated seller profile {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: notification_email_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether email notifications are enabled for order, payment, and review updates.

plainFields.name: notification_push_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether push notifications are enabled for critical alerts.

plainFields.name: payout_threshold
plainFields.description: Minimum balance required to request a payout (in local currency).

plainFields.name: currency_display
plainFields.description: Preferred currency for display in seller dashboard (ISO 4217 code).

plainFields.name: auto_approve_reviews
plainFields.description: Whether reviews should be auto-approved without admin moderation.

plainFields.name: show_feedback_button
plainFields.description: Whether to display the feedback button to customers on storefront.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the settings were created for this seller profile.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the settings were last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the settings were soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_payouts
models.description:
Financial disbursements sent to sellers for their sales revenue.

Tracks all payout transactions from the platform to seller bank accounts. Each payout represents a payment to a seller for accumulated sales revenue, after deducting platform fees. Payouts are batched daily and processed through the payment gateway system.

Payouts have distinct status states based on processing stage. Payouts can be canceled if initiated in error. Payout history is critical for accounting and tax compliance. Timestamps include creation, processing, and completion times for full auditability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Seller receiving the payout {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_bank_account_id
foreignFields.description: Bank account receiving the payout {@link shopping_mall_seller_bank_accounts.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Payout status: requested, processing, completed, failed, canceled.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Total payout amount in local currency before platform fees.

plainFields.name: platform_fee
plainFields.description: Platform's service fee deducted from payout amount.

plainFields.name: net_amount
plainFields.description: Net amount credited to seller's bank account (amount - platform_fee).

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency of the payout (ISO 4217 code).

plainFields.name: batch_id
plainFields.description: Identifier for the batch of payouts processed together in the payment gateway.

plainFields.name: paid_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when funds were successfully transferred to the bank account.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payout request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payout status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the payout was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sales_reports
models.description:
Accumulated sales data and financial metrics for seller performance analysis.

Contains aggregated, read-only sales data generated from seller transactions. This table serves as a materialized view for performance metrics and includes daily, weekly, monthly, and year-to-date summaries. Reports are automatically generated and referenced by sellers through their dashboard interface.

All data in this table is derived from other transactions and should not be modified directly. The table is structured as a subsidiary entity since it's generated by the system and never created by users. All fields are read-only and updated by scheduled jobs.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Seller for whom the sales report is generated {@link shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: period_start
plainFields.description: Start date of the reporting period (usually the first day of the period).

plainFields.name: period_end
plainFields.description: End date of the reporting period (usually the last day of the period).

plainFields.name: total_sales
plainFields.description: Total gross sales amount for the period before platform fees.

plainFields.name: total_orders
plainFields.description: Total number of completed orders during the period.

plainFields.name: total_items_sold
plainFields.description: Total number of product units sold during the period.

plainFields.name: average_order_value
plainFields.description: Average value of orders during the period (total_sales / total_orders).

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount of refunds processed during the period.

plainFields.name: platform_fee_total
plainFields.description: Total platform fees collected from seller sales during the period.

plainFields.name: payout_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount paid out to seller during the period.

plainFields.name: product_views
plainFields.description: Total number of product listing views during the period.

plainFields.name: conversion_rate
plainFields.description: Customer conversion rate calculated as (total_orders / product_views) * 100.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this report snapshot was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this report was last recalculated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this report was soft-deleted by admin action.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_actions
models.description:
Records all administrative actions performed on the platform.

Tracks every action taken by an administrator including user suspensions, product removals, order cancellations, and policy changes. Each action is associated with a specific administrator and contains context about the target resource and the action performed. This table serves as the primary audit log for platform governance and compliance.

All actions are immutable records. No direct user modifications are permitted. After creation, the only permitted operation is soft deletion with a reason for archival purposes.

This information is critical for forensic investigations, regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA), and internal accountability.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who performed this action. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed. Examples: 'suspend_user', 'approve_seller', 'remove_product', 'refund_order', 'delete_review'.

plainFields.name: target_resource_id
plainFields.description: ID of the target resource affected (e.g., user_id, product_id, order_id, review_id). It can reference any other entity in the system.

plainFields.name: target_resource_type
plainFields.description: Type of the target resource affected (e.g., 'shopping_mall_customers', 'shopping_mall_products', 'shopping_mall_orders', 'shopping_mall_product_reviews'). Used to determine the relationship context.

plainFields.name: action_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the action performed, including real-time context, configuration changes, and human-readable explanation of what was done.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrative action was performed. Useful for security analysis and detecting unusual activity.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string from the administrator's browser or application client. Helps identify device and client used for inspection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative action was recorded. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last modified. Updated when status changes or description is edited.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin action was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Comprehensive audit trail of all system configurations and administrative boundary changes.

This table captures every configuration change and policy modification made by administrators. Unlike admin_actions, which logs actions on business entities, this table logs changes to the system's core rules and rules engine itself.

Includes changes to: permission sets, system settings, approval workflows, rate limits, product categories, and content moderation rules. Every modification is recorded with before/after values and the administrator responsible.

Critical for compliance, reproducibility, and understanding how system behavior evolved over time. Every setting change is immutable after creation and preserved for audit.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who performed this configuration change. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: setting_name
plainFields.description: Name of the system setting or policy that was changed. Examples: 'max_review_length', 'refund_period_days', 'seller_verification_threshold'.

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: The previous value of the setting before the change. Stored as string representation to handle any data type (JSON, number, string, boolean).

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: The new value assigned to the setting after the change. Stored as string representation to handle any data type (JSON, number, string, boolean).

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Explanation from the administrator for why this change was made. Required field for all configuration alterations.

plainFields.name: setting_type
plainFields.description: Category of system setting changed. Examples: 'security', 'payment', 'shipping', 'moderation', 'user_permissions', 'business_rules'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration change was recorded. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit record was last modified. Updated when metadata is edited.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin audit log was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_dispute_resolutions
models.description:
Logs final resolutions for customer disputes handled by administrative staff.

Captures the complete lifecycle and outcome of every customer dispute case resolved by an admin. Includes all relevant context, communication history, evidence reviewed, financial adjustments, and final decision rationale.

This table is the authoritative record of how disputes were settled, ensuring accountability, consistency, and legal compliance. Each dispute is resolved by exactly one admin, and the outcome is final and unchangeable after resolution.

The resolution status is critical for reporting on dispute patterns, seller performance, and platform fairness.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who resolved this dispute case. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order ID related to this dispute case. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the dispute resolution. Valid values: 'pending_review', 'resolved_refund', 'resolved_no_refund', 'resolved_partial', 'escalated_to_owner'.

plainFields.name: resolution_type
plainFields.description: Type of resolution applied. Examples: 'full_refund', 'partial_refund', 'replacement', 'store_credit', 'dismissed'.

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of money refunded to customer in USD, if applicable. Null if no refund was issued.

plainFields.name: resolution_notes
plainFields.description: Detailed notes explaining the reasoning behind the resolution, including evidence considered, policy exceptions, and contact with customer/seller.

plainFields.name: resolution_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the dispute was officially resolved by the admin. This is immutable once set.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this dispute record was created in the system. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this dispute record was last modified. Updated when status or resolution notes change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this dispute resolution was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_permissions
models.description:
Defines and manages the permission sets and access roles for administrative users.

Stores the granular permission rules that determine what actions each admin can perform. Unlike role-based access control, this system supports fine-grained permissions on a per-action basis.

Administrators inherit permissions through assigned permission sets. Each admin can belong to one or more permission groups. This allows flexible delegation of responsibilities without direct hierarchy.

Includes all permissions for user management, product moderation, order handling, financial adjustments, and system configuration.

This table represents the blueprint for access control and must be protected against unauthorized modification.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator to whom this permission set is directly assigned. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: permission_group
plainFields.description: Name of the permission group this assignment belongs to. Examples: 'moderator', 'finance', 'logging_admin', 'super_admin'.

plainFields.name: permission
plainFields.description: Specific permission granted. Examples: 'user_suspend', 'product_remove', 'order_refund', 'setting_change', 'view_all_audit_logs'.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Scope of this permission. Examples: 'global' (all entities), 'seller_specific' (only seller's products), 'category_specific' (certain categories).

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Date and time when this permission assignment becomes active.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description: Date and time when this permission assignment expires. If null, permission is permanent.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was created. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last modified. Updated when effective dates change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_settings
models.description:
Contains operational and policy settings managed by administrators with workflow states.

Stores system-wide configuration options that require approval and lifecycle management, such as platform fees, refund windows, review policies, and moderation thresholds. Unlike audit logs, this table represents the current live configuration with status tracking.

Each setting can be proposed, approved, or rejected, providing an audit trail for changes. Only approved settings are active in the system. Configuration changes never overwrite directly - they go through a review workflow.

This table ensures complete transparency and accountability for any change that affects platform-wide business rules or user experience.

foreignFields.name: proposed_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who proposed this setting change. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

foreignFields.name: approved_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who approved this setting change. Null if not approved yet. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: setting_key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for this system setting. Examples: 'platform_fee_percentage', 'refund_window_days', 'review_moderation_time', 'inventory_low_threshold'.

plainFields.name: current_value
plainFields.description: The value currently active in the system. Represented as string to handle any data type (JSON, number, string, boolean).

plainFields.name: proposed_value
plainFields.description: The value proposed to replace the current value. Represented as string to handle any data type (JSON, number, string, boolean).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of this configuration change. Valid values: 'draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'rejected', 'deprecated'.

plainFields.name: proposal_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by the proposing admin for this change. Required for all proposals.

plainFields.name: approval_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by the approving admin for accepting this change. Required when status is 'approved'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting proposal was created. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting record was last modified. Updated when status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_system_notifications
models.description:
A centralized system for sending broadcast notifications from admin system to users in response to critical events.

Tracks all system-wide notifications delivered to users as a result of administrative actions or system events. Examples: platform maintenance announcements, policy updates, service outages, or important platform-wide changes.

This table is distinct from user-specific alerts (e.g., order updates) and serves as the official communication channel for platform-level announcements that affect all users or specific user segments.

Notifications may be targeted by user role, region, or specific user segments, and are archived after delivery for audit and compliance.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who initiated this system notification. {@link shopping_mall_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: Category of this notification. Examples: 'maintenance', 'policy_update', 'security_alert', 'system_outage', 'feature_launch'.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short title for the notification. This is the subject line that appears in UI and email.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Full body of the notification message. May contain HTML for formatting. Targeted at end users.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Who should receive this notification. Examples: 'all_users', 'customers', 'sellers', 'admin_only', 'region:asia'.

plainFields.name: send_status
plainFields.description: Current delivery status of this notification. Examples: 'draft', 'scheduled', 'sent', 'partial_failure', 'failed'.

plainFields.name: scheduled_delivery
plainFields.description: Date and time when this notification is scheduled to be delivered. May be in the future.

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when this notification was actually delivered to users. Null before delivery.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification record was created. Always populated and immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification record was last modified. Updated when status, schedule, or target changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this notification was soft-deleted. If null, the record is active. Used for compliance purposes to preserve audit trails while hiding from UI.
